tools.name: ferry_status
tools.title: Ferry's box and devices
tools.description: Ferry, the user's mailbox between their phone and computers over Tailscale: on (the server runs), tailscale, url (the phone's address), setup (what's missing, or null), devices (id, name, kind phone or computer, online) and the box's items, newest last: what came to this computer (to "computer", from a device: a text, or a file with its path in ~/Downloads) and what was sent from here (to "phone", for a device). Use it to read what the user sent from their phone, and for a device's id before ferry_send_files or ferry_send_text.

tools.name: ferry_send_files
tools.title: Send files with Ferry
tools.description: Sends files (a folder: its files) from this computer to one of the user's devices with Ferry: to a phone into its box, with a notification; to another computer straight into its Downloads. Only files in the user's home folder: nothing hidden (no part of the path starting with a dot, and a folder's hidden files are left out), no link that leads out of home, and not home or its own folders (Downloads, Documents…) whole; one path that breaks this stops the whole send, and that is the user's rule, so don't try another way. The user allows it on screen first. Fails with the reason when the device is asleep or the files aren't there.

paths.title: Files
paths.description: Absolute paths of files or folders in home (~ works too)

to.title: Device
to.description: The device's id or name from ferry_status's devices

tools.name: ferry_send_text
tools.title: Send a text with Ferry
tools.description: Sends a text (a link, a note, an address) to one of the user's devices with Ferry: to a phone into its box, with a notification; to another computer as a text in its box. The user allows it on screen first.

to.title: Device
to.description: The device's id or name from ferry_status's devices
